purpose: Compile receipt-bound, label-safe structural transformation coverage before any delta-model fit.

scope.group_unit: frozen D-032 similarity-component proxy; not a semantic SAR-family identity
scope.r4_authority_boundary: Coverage evidence may authorize a separate oracle-contract freeze only; it never authorizes a fit, prediction, metric, scorer, submission, TDI, or transductive operation.
scope.selected_anchor_gate: Structural coverage applies to every public episode with episode_policy_id selected_anchor, independent of endpoint.
scope.later_oracle_prerequisite: A separate oracle contract must preflight trusted selector==CYP3A4 plus complete anchor/query validity before any fit; R4 does not access selector or scorable facts.
scope.local_authoritative_gate: CYP3A4 state-only aggregate gate from the frozen topology viability receipt; no endpoint availability is emitted per row.

direct_projection.record_scanner: RFC4180 quote-aware scan; validate the exact header before yielding any data record.

mask_projection.opaque_suffix_span: anchor_observation_references and anchor_value_availability_mask remain one opaque byte span.
mask_projection.anchor_identity_usage: structural anchor join only; no activity value, selector, or label is exposed
mask_projection.record_scanner: RFC4180 quote-aware scan; validate the exact header before yielding any data record.

extraction_spec_receipt.material_encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON object with sorted keys and compact separators; material includes extraction_spec_id plus the listed extraction subtrees.

candidate_generation.pair_identity: one canonical unordered pair; derive directional views after extraction
candidate_generation.candidate_cap: none for the exact receipt-bound local-pair and episode populations

fragmentation.order: Enumerate single cuts first; enumerate double cuts only when no valid single cut remains.
fragmentation.single_cut_normalization: rdMMPA's returned core is empty for a single cut. Split the result into exactly two dot components, each carrying the same [*:1] attachment label; consider both orientations as conserved constant versus variable and match a pair only when the canonical labeled constants are identical.
fragmentation.double_cut_normalization: For a double cut, rdMMPA's returned nonempty core is the variable component; the dot sidechains are the conserved constant. Normalize exactly two attachment-label permutations: identity (1,2) and swap (2,1).
fragmentation.virtual_hydrogen_generation: For each eligible common-constant attachment atom with an implicit hydrogen, generate one variable [*:1][H] view and match it to an ordinary single-cut constant; hydrogen contributes zero heavy atoms and zero changed heavy-atom indices.
fragmentation.stereo_policy: Ignore stereo only to test identical full heavy-atom graphs. Record a stereo change only when every changed stereo element is explicitly specified on both sides and there is a unique full-graph correspondence, or every valid graph map yields the same record; otherwise emit C3/AMBIGUOUS. Unspecified or mixed stereo blocks only stereo-specific records; ordinary non-stereo MMP records remain eligible.

canonicalization.dummy_permutation: Enumerate equivalent dummy labels and retain the lexicographically minimal representation only to deduplicate isomorphic encodings.
canonicalization.core_matching: Exact canonical labeled-constant matching for single cuts and exact canonical conserved-sidechain matching for double cuts; no fuzzy or learned matching.
canonicalization.canonical_atom_indices: Reparse the exact canonical standardized SMILES and use its RDKit atom indices. If valid graph maps produce different changed-index sets or transformation records, mark the candidate AMBIGUOUS; molecule IDs never resolve the ambiguity.
canonicalization.heavy_atom_count: Count atoms with atomic number >1 after canonical reparsing; dummies and virtual hydrogens are excluded.
canonicalization.changed_heavy_atom_fraction: Reduced exact rational (removed_heavy_atoms + added_heavy_atoms) / (left_heavy_atoms + right_heavy_atoms), with heavy atoms excluding dummies and hydrogen; serialize numerator/denominator without floating-point rounding.
canonicalization.attachment_environment_rule: Serialize each attachment environment as an exact canonical rooted radius-1 or radius-2 fragment SMILES with a temporary root atom map 1. Compare exact strings; for two cuts sum the number of matching rooted strings at each radius.
canonicalization.attachment_environment_id_representation: A compact JSON array of canonical rooted environment strings ordered by normalized attachment label; length is exactly one for single cuts and two for double cuts.
canonicalization.canonical_representation_tiebreak: Canonical representation may deduplicate isomorphic encodings but may never scientifically rank chemically distinct candidates.
canonicalization.ambiguity: Chemically distinct decompositions tied after all ranks are ambiguous and excluded from valid v1 transformations.
canonicalization.unsupported: No valid single- or double-cut decomposition is a row state UNSUPPORTED, not a deterministic terminal failure.

standardization_changed.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

multiple_fragments_input.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

stereochemistry_unspecified_or_mixed.policy: block only stereo-specific records; ordinary non-stereo MMP records remain eligible

prohibited_ring_cut.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

ambiguous_decomposition.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

stereo_specific_without_confident_exact_.policy: exclude row; do not terminate the run

ids.hash_encoding: Every ID is lowercase SHA256 hex of UTF-8 compact canonical JSON array bytes: json.dumps(array, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).
ids.direction_id: SHA256(compact JSON array [spec_hash, transformation_pair_id, anchor_standardized_structure_hash, analog_standardized_structure_hash])
ids.exact_transformation_id: SHA256(compact JSON array [spec_hash, removed_labeled_fragment, added_labeled_fragment, attachment_labels_array, direction_id])
ids.undirected_exchange_id: SHA256(compact JSON array [spec_hash, sorted_fragment_pair, attachment_arity]); identical for both directions

pair_population.source: All distinct molecule pairs within a frozen similarity component with inclusive Tanimoto >=0.60, unioned with all expanded episode anchor-query pairs.
pair_population.base_structural_candidates: All within-component >=0.60 candidates; endpoint eligibility never filters transformation_pairs.csv.
pair_population.union_key: transformation_pair_id from standardized structure hashes; extract each union pair once
pair_population.local_endpoint_counts: Retained only as aggregate diagnostics from the exact local-pair replay.
pair_population.local_pair_semantics: true only for a structural pair whose molecules share the same similarity component and whose inclusive Tanimoto similarity is >=0.60; endpoint state never defines local_pair.
pair_population.episode_pair_semantics: true only for a structural anchor-query pair expanded from a public episode; label state never defines episode_pair.

local_pairs.eligibility: Replay exact complete eligible local-pair membership from the frozen topology artifact without parsing numeric magnitudes.
local_pairs.output_role: aggregate diagnostic only; does not restrict the structural union pair population
local_pairs.local_pair_semantics: same component and inclusive Tanimoto >=0.60 only; no endpoint availability is exposed

episodes.selected_anchor_policy: All public rows with episode_policy_id selected_anchor receive endpoint-agnostic structural coverage.
episodes.episode_pair_semantics: structural anchor-query membership only; no endpoint availability or scorable state

transformation_pairs.csv.rows: one canonical row per unique union structural candidate pair

episode_transformations.csv.support_semantics: CYP3A4 exact and class support counts use only training-side families and exclude the held-out outer group; no endpoint availability, selector, or oracle/scorable state is emitted.

union.denominator: number of distinct union structural candidate rows
union.status_counts: count all six status values over the union denominator

each_local_endpoint.denominator: number of structurally eligible local rows for that endpoint; status counts include all six values

selected_primary.denominator: number of expanded selected_anchor public episode rows in the primary diagnostic partition
selected_primary.status_counts: all six status values; gates/frequencies/support use valid statuses only

stress.denominator: number of expanded public episode rows in the stress diagnostic partition
stress.status_counts: all six status values; gates/frequencies/support use valid statuses only

transformation_coverage.json.fraction_denominator: single_cut_fraction, double_cut_fraction, ambiguous_fraction, and unsupported_fraction use the corresponding union/local/selected_primary/stress partition denominator; status counts are mutually exhaustive.
transformation_coverage.json.changed_distribution_denominator: valid transformation rows only: VALID_STEREO, VALID_SINGLE, VALID_DOUBLE

cross_cyp_valid_transformation_sharing.eligibility: share only transformation IDs with a valid status in at least two endpoint aggregate partitions

outputs.serialization: RFC4180 CSV with LF line endings and one terminal newline; canonical JSON with sorted keys, two-space indentation, and one terminal newline.
outputs.publication: Stage, validate, make read-only, and atomically publish with Linux renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE); never overwrite or publish a partial root.

support.support_unit: distinct frozen D-032 similarity-component proxy family, not raw pair count
support.precedence_rule: Integrity failure outranks clean underpowered, which outranks supported.
support.supported_interpretation: Geometry and coverage evidence only; permits freezing a separate oracle contract and nothing downstream.
anti_inflation_rules: Count support by distinct frozen training proxy family, never raw pair or repeated episode count.
Exclude the held-out outer group from every training-family support count.
Count each union structural pair once even when it is both local and episode-derived.
Count both directions as views of one pair, never as two pairs.
Count repeated exact transformations and classes once per training family.
Episode repetition and query rank cannot increase training-family support.

authority.status_note: The contract is frozen but unimplemented. A supported run grants geometry/coverage evidence and permission to freeze a separate oracle contract only.

failure_policy.integrity_failure: Receipt, schema, firewall, runtime, atomic-publication, or other integrity failure emits only failure_receipt.json and does not emit coverage artifacts.
failure_policy.clean_underpowered: Emit the four success artifacts with status R4_TRANSFORMATION_COVERAGE_UNDERPOWERED and preserve all coverage evidence.
failure_policy.supported: Emit the four success artifacts with status R4_TRANSFORMATION_COVERAGE_SUPPORTED; do not fit or score anything.
failure_policy.row_failure_code_field_scope: success-artifact failure_code fields may contain only row_exclusion_codes; terminal_integrity_failure_codes appear only in failure_receipt.json.
failure_policy.row_status_policy: AMBIGUOUS, UNSUPPORTED, and STANDARDIZATION_HAZARD are row states recorded in success artifacts and contribute to clean underpowered evidence; none is terminal integrity failure by itself.
terminal_integrity_conditions: distinct molecule identities sharing a standardized_structure_hash; fail closed and never use molecule ID as a rescue tiebreak
